# Davy Keith

- **Age:** Seven to eight years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 c27 P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** Orphaned; adopted into Green Gables  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>; Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v2 c24 P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair and handsome little boy with a crop of fuzzy yellow ringlets all over his round head. He has roguish, dancing hazel eyes, a snub nose, and a mouth full of smiles. He features a single dimple in one cheek, giving him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs, with mirth and mischief evident in his face.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 c25 P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy is full of mischief, energy, and constant curiosity, frequently driving others to exasperation with his endless questions. Though prone to impish pranks and heedless obedience, he possesses an affectionate, impulsive nature and a knack for winning love. He responds deeply to Anne's guidance and genuinely tries to reform his behavior, though his love of fun and appetite often get the better of him. He is straightforward and vocal about his likes and dislikes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 c10 P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c18 P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 c19 P45](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0045)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were left orphans upon the death of their mother, Mary Keith. Because Mary was a third cousin to Marilla Cuthbert's late relative, Marilla brought the children to Green Gables to live. From the moment he arrived, Davy proved to be a constant handful, indulging in endless physical activity, snatching cake, and playing pranks. Within his first few days, he dropped a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, coaxed his sister into falling into a pigpen, and placed a toad in Marilla's bed. Under Anne Shirley's gentle and understanding guidance, Davy gradually began learning moral lessons against lying, stealing jam, and disobeying rules, though he frequently lapsed into accidental mischief. He started attending Avonlea School alongside his sister, sitting with Milty Boulter and joining in schoolboy squabbles and games. Following the death of his uncle Richard Keith, a trust fund was established for Davy and Dora, securing their permanent home at Green Gables.
